$comment: AUTHORED — the one file you edit to add or change a map layer. Run `pnpm style:build`, then commit the generated style.json + style.meta.json. Colours reference tokens; the VALUES that drive a colouring are not in the tiles, so every non-static mode must name the provider it reads.

layers.$comment: ONE geometry, MANY colourings. Exactly one mode is active at a time; the user picks via a view (below). Each mode names the runtime feature-state property that drives it.

discharge.label: Water level
discharge.$comment: `missing` is the NEUTRAL plain-water colour, not status.unknown. About 19,250 of 19,700 waters have no gauge, so this paints most of the map: using the regulatory-unknown violet here would mean 'we could not parse the rule' and 'there is no gauge' were the same colour.

providers.$comment: Where a colour mode's values come from. Tiles carry IDENTITY (section_id) and almost nothing else — status and discharge live in the bundle and the live feed. The app fetches per visible feature and pushes feature-state; the tiles never change.

regs.$comment: computed from rules + the selected date. Present for the 2.4% with an assessed rule; everything else is default_only.

gauges.$comment: 450 stations, 30-min refresh. Binds to item_id (durable), so it must fan out to that item's sections to colour a line.

stocking.$comment: per-waterbody release records, refreshed weekly. Two weeks is the stale threshold: one missed run is normal, two means the job is broken. Bound to item_id — stocking is INTO a lake, not onto a reach.

in_season.$comment: mid-cycle closures and openings the printed synopsis cannot carry, scraped every 6 h. Twelve hours is the stale threshold — two missed runs. This is the ONLY channel that can correct a wrong answer between builds, so a client that cannot reach it must say 'could not check for a closure', never imply none.

$toggleable_groups: No third-party overlay ships yet. Private parcels was drafted here and REMOVED: its attribution was the string 'TODO', which the old guard accepted because it only checked the field was non-empty. A licensed layer must not reach a store on a placeholder. To add one: declare the source with external:true and a real provider + licence, add a toggleable group, add a layer whose colorModes use water.* or a family matching its provider. The build will refuse anything less.
